definition: The power to do anything, without limits or restrictions.
author: Mary Shelley
quote: All my speculations and hopes are as nothing, and like the archangel who aspired to omnipotence, I am chained in an eternal hell.
example_sentence: Holding the remote gave my little brother a brief taste of omnipotence.
